name: Bitpanda
verdict: Owned by Bitpanda Group AG, the holding of the Vienna-based crypto and investing platform. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Bitpanda is the brand of Bitpanda Group AG. Its supervisory board (founders, Valar Ventures' James Fitzgerald, Hedosophia's Caspar Wahler and other members) has no state official or state-fund executive, and no source names a state or state-fund shareholder; the full shareholder register isn't public. No human-rights finding against the company by a court, regulator, UN body or major NGO was found. Bitpanda's BaFin/FMA licences and MiCA registration are financial-regulatory matters and do not count under METHOD.md.
